meaning: rice noodles; thin noodles made from rice, often stir-fried or served in soup

example.romanization: A-mè chau mî-fun pun ngài shi̍t.
example.english: Mom stir-fried rice noodles for me to eat.

note: Fried rice noodles (炒米粉) are a classic Hakka dish in Taiwan, especially associated with Hsinchu, and are a staple at festivals and family gatherings.
